correctness.rationale: Strict positivity fixes the unitary polar factor; binomial conjugacy follows by induction. A uniform complex-contour Gaussian moment estimate yields the exact Hermite symbol on every finite diagonal, with exponentially dominated tails. Banded Toeplitz block approximation and quasi-Schatten tail inequalities yield the signed spectral cloud and sharp all-p constants; localization plus wave packets proves the norm constant. The exact three-site HS identity and numerical limits were checked by the included executable; numerical work is not used as an infinite proof.

The possibility of a known general theorem implying most of the claim is a priority limitation rather than a novelty proof.

value.rationale: The natural question of quantitative convergence of normalized mean-transform orbits is answered at all Schatten quasi-Banach exponents, not only in operator norm. The first surviving spatial moment alone fixes the critical exponent, while the full Fourier polynomial of noncommuting matrix diagonals fixes the exact constants and signed spectral cloud. The explicit offdiagonal three-site example exhibits norm/trace contrast and a closed-form HS identity.
